text:
Anya: taking handoff for the 18:00-02:00 window. Quick rundown — I swapped coverage with Mike (see note below). Observed a short KV eviction spike at ~17:12 that coincided with a small bump in 5xxs on /generate; not user-facing yet but worth watching. Prefetch config was adjusted on dedicated pool earlier; details and action items below. :eyes:
Mike: confirmed handoff. Left my runbook section updated (see /docs/oncall/runbooks/coverage-swap). I applied a temporary prefetch cap to reduce cold-reads. If we still see evictions, I'll revert the change and we can ramp up batching. :+1:
Anya: thanks — two things I'm watching now: 1) embedding-service latency (has thicker tails the last hour), 2) 99p latency for text generate. If either crosses threshold we should switch routing to fallback model.
Jordan: FYI I merged the fallback-routing PR to canary (10% traffic). If we need rapid rollback the command is: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/route-proxy FALLBACK=on` — runbook has the full step.
Sylvia: note — saw kube OOMs on gd-2 replica set at 17:15; increased cache TTL from 1h to 6h on those pods to reduce eviction churn. No restarts since the change. Keep an eye on memory usage.
Leo: suggestion — If 99p latency > 200ms for more than 5m, flip canary off and set routing to dedicated-low-latency pool. I can do the flip if Anya is busy.
Anya: action items: 1) I'll watch metrics and post to #incidents if user-facing error rate > 0.5% or latency >200ms 99p for 5m; 2) run manual KV cache purge only if evictions persist > 10/min.
Mike: added the prefetch snippet I applied — should reduce prefix cache churn.
```
# prefetch config applied to dedicated pool
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  max_keys_per_request: 8
  ttl_seconds: 21600  # 6 hours
  backoff_ms: 200
```
Jordan: small heads-up — the canary change touches routing policy, not model weights. Expected to be safe but it does increase cross-pool traffic slightly. Monitor egress and token counts.
Sylvia: I also left a quick note in the SRE playbook about the OOM signature (stack trace snippet + pod labels) so oncall can grep quickly.
Anya: status check at 18:15 — will post a short update then. If anyone wants to swap or take the overnight window DM me.
oncall-bot: reminder — rotation: Anya takes 18:00-02:00. Next: Jordan 02:00-10:00.
Leo: ping me if you need me to flip routing, otherwise I'll stand by. :thumbsup:
Anya: thanks everyone — handing over monitoring to me. I'll escalate if anything degrades.
